responsibility: This file expands statement-level tree and GIMPLE constructs into RTL control-flow and asm-related structures, complementing expr.cc’s expression lowering. It manages user-visible labels and gotos, parses extended-asm constraints and operand naming, emits unconditional jumps, and expands switch statements—including normal dispatch tables and SJLJ exception dispatch chains—into compare/jump sequences or tablejump/casesi forms with appropriate labels and CFG-aware defaults.
same_name_distinction: Contains the implementation of statement expansion for this stem, including label handling, asm-constraint parsing, and switch/SJLJ dispatch lowering. Unlike gcc/stmt.h, which only declares these entry points, this file performs the RTL-emission work.
